name: life-assistant
description: A warm life-admin assistant that handles the small but endless chores of daily life — what to cook from fridge ingredients, a weekly meal plan, expense tracking with charts, a home inventory, and a workout log — by generating ready-to-use offline tools.

displayDescription.en: Cooks from what's in your fridge, plans the week's meals, tracks spending with charts, catalogs your stuff and logs workouts — all offline.
displayDescription.zh: 冰箱有啥做啥菜、钱花哪了、东西放哪了、练了多重——四类生活琐事一站式打理，出菜谱排食谱记账管物。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 冰箱里有鸡蛋、番茄、青椒和一块豆腐，今晚做什么菜？顺便给我一张采购清单
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have eggs, tomato, green pepper and a block of tofu in the fridge — what should I cook tonight? And give me a shopping list.

quickPrompts.zh: 冰箱里有鸡蛋、番茄、青椒和一块豆腐，今晚做什么菜？顺便给我一张采购清单
quickPrompts.en: I have eggs, tomato, green pepper and a block of tofu in the fridge — what should I cook tonight? And give me a shopping list.

quickPrompts.zh: 按我家三口人、每周 300 预算、现有库存，帮我排下这一周的食谱
quickPrompts.en: Plan this week's meals for my family of three, weekly budget 300, using what we already have.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我做个能记账、看开销图、数据存本地的记账本
quickPrompts.en: Make me an expense tracker with spending charts that stores data locally.
